text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle is 1st!!
A magnificent victory for K.S. Miracle,
showing off that blistering speed!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Holy... crap... Did you see that speed?!
They call short-distance races a blitzkrieg, but seriously...
Man, that literally gave me chills...!!

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
I heard that with Bamboo Memory, Daiichi Ruby,
and Daitaku Helios around, the sprint scene
is getting really heated right now, butâ

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
And there comes K.S.Miracle!!
Could it be!?
Is she coming up on the outside~?!?!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
"No... seriously speaking.
I think it's definitely happening, big time...!"

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: I saw it! Just the other day, in that Tracen Academy coverage video on UmaTube...!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
It was footage of a sprint...
a 1,200-meter mock race, but...

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Unlike middle- and long-distance races, in sprints,
the winning margins aren't that huge to begin with, right?

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: It's partly because speedsters naturally gather here, but... there's just no distance to pull away in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: Still...!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
She was the only one winning by huge margins!
Like, by 8 or 9 lengths!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that mean...! That only she... only her speed—

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
You're sayin' they were just built totally different...!
Man, this is gettin' me fired up! Seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm!!
She'll definitely show us a run that can take on
even our current sprint seniors...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO!!
Keep doing your best, Miracleee!!
We're counting on youuuuu!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for the cheers.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Right... I'm going to do this.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Ruby and her peers, of course. But I know very well that the other girls running sprint races right now are all strong and fast too.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Still... that's exactly why I have to do it. In a GⅠ race. On the pinnacle stage where the fastest gather.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (—At the Sprinters Stakes. When I proved my speed was second to none...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Only if I can make such a miracle happen...
will my dream come true.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I can finally convey my "thank you" to everyone...
in the very best way possible.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I will do it. ...I will win.
Without stopping, without hesitating, I'll charge forward.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Squeezing out every last bit of speed I can muster—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Her leg.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I suppose that's true—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After the race that ended with a splendid first-place finish,
and after the dazzling Winning Live was over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, I would have preferred to return to the inn
early and let her rest, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was held up a bit by the press, so I was
late getting back to the waiting room.
choice_data_list: Sorry Miracle, sorry to keep you—... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She must be exhausted. Looking up at the clock, I confirm there's no rush to leave just yet.
If possible, I'd like to let her sleep a little longer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching over K.S. Miracle as she sleeps slumped over the desk, I also take a seat in a chair.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While doing that for a bit...
something suddenly came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, who did I hear this from again?
Supposedly, she's surprisingly—
choice_data_list: (Apparently she talks loudly in her sleep, from what I've heard)
(Apparently she talks loudly in her sleep, or so I hear)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She'd probably be embarrassed if she knew I overheard, so maybe I should cover my ears? Such idle thoughts drift through my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I think it through—and realize.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Not a word.
Sure, there are times when people don't talk in their sleep, but what still bothers me isâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was because it was "too quiet".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Far from talking in his sleep—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because I can't even hear breathing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
Did I fall asleep...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...?
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?
You look pale...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though K.S. Miracle looked a little sleepy,
seeing her usual demeanor helped the tension in my body
gradually melt away."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was I overthinking it?
No, but still... No, wait—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, um.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry I dozed off.
You waited for me to wake up, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... shall we head out now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I held a meeting with K.S.Miracle
to discuss her next goals, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For our goal, would it be okay
to just keep running the Summer Sprint series?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, next up is the CBC Sho next month—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almost reflexively, I shake my head.
Naturally, the nervousness from back then
is no longer lingering in my body, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The memory of the chill that ran through my entire body.
...It was still far too vivid.
choice_data_list: Let's leave a little more space between us.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
More?
...How much more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't just base things on anxieties bordering on delusion.
I explain to K.S.Miracle that I simply want
her to give her body some rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though we were aiming for the Summer Sprint,
considering the current situation and the toll on her legs and body,
we decided—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
It's all for the sake of my health, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Two months... In that case—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How about... the Keeneland Cup
in late August?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was hesitant, but it meets the conditions.
Deciding that I ought to yield, I nodded in agreement.
choice_data_list: Got it. Next up is the Keeneland Cup.
Got it. Next up is the Keeneland Cup.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Since you're giving me a break, I'll do my best to win next time, too.
I'll aim for first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle is full of motivation.
...However, I should pay even closer attention
to her condition and how she's doing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We are at summer camp, and considering our
major post-summer goal, the Sprinters Stakes,
it's important to train hard. However—
choice_data_list: (First, let's make this a summer of proper rest!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that resolve in mind, I brought the meeting to an end.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...You really are kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I wish I could express it better.
...To say that I'm fine.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even without rest, even without stopping.
I'll be fine.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because my...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...That's just the kind of person I am.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Being able to start running was a miracle.
Being able to keep running is a miracle too... but—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Miracles... don't last forever.
"The blue bird."

"Today, and today again, I keep on flying.
Today, tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow."

"For happiness, to deliver it far and wide,
Today, and today, and today, and today."
"Even if I get hurt"
"Even if I get hurt."
